AutoPostOnline Agent Skill 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Enables autonomous AI agents to safely draft, schedule, publish, and analyze social media posts via AutoPostOnline.
- Provides a secure publishing layer, avoiding direct handling of social passwords or browser sessions.
- Supports both "safe mode" (owner approval workflow) and "autonomous mode" (fully automated posting within approved rules).
- Details integration listing as a required first action to prevent publishing errors.
- Outlines clear agent behavior rules for content safety, platform adaptation, and error handling.
